description: This file defines a utility class 'SaddlePointExpansion' used internally by the Apache Commons Math library to perform accurate calculations related to the binomial distribution, specifically for computing probability mass functions via saddle point approximation methods.

classes.name: SaddlePointExpansion
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for saddle point approximation calculations related to binomial probabilities, including Stirling error calculation, deviance parts, and log PMF computation.

methods.name: getStirlingError
methods.description: Computes the error of Stirling's approximation for the given value, switching between lookup and asymptotic expansion depending on the value.

methods.name: getDeviancePart
methods.description: Calculates a component of the deviance used in saddle point approximation, with specialized handling for values close to the mean.

methods.name: logBinomialProbability
methods.description: Calculates the logarithm of the binomial probability mass function using saddle point expansion, accounting for edge cases at the boundaries.
